phase3_findings.summary: Bootstrap canonical-draft-write recipe still claims 'the identical Step 4 sub-step 2 recipe' and names the shallow `mkdir -p "$MAIN_ROOT/.prflow/tmp"`, but the actual Step 4 sub-step 2 recipe (step-4-present-create.md:32) was deepened to `mkdir -p "$MAIN_ROOT/.prflow/tmp/create-issue/<slug>"`. The 'identical' invariant is now false and the quoted mkdir literal is inconsistent with its named mirror.
phase3_findings.inertness_basis: The staged canonical-draft write goes through scripts/stage-draft-write.py, whose _atomic_write does directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True), so the nested create-issue/<slug>/ dir is created regardless and the draft still lands nested (no flat artifact, AC1/AC2 hold). Capped at Minor/Suggestion.
phase3_findings.suggested_fix: Update the literal at line 18 to `mkdir -p "$MAIN_ROOT/.prflow/tmp/create-issue/<slug>"` to restore the 'identical recipe' mirror.

phase3_findings.summary: The reaper invocation embeds command substitution ($(git rev-parse...), $(resolve-main-root.sh)) and ${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR} expansion in argument position, shapes the cloud matcher denies silently. On a cloud create-issue run cleanup would no-op and scratch would accumulate.
phase3_findings.non_blocking_basis: This substitution/expansion pattern is pervasive across create-issue references (e.g. same file line 129 gh-api write), so create-issue behaves as a local/interactive command; this is not a regression introduced by the PR. Cleanup is best-effort by design; failure never blocks issue creation.

phase3_findings.summary: Pointer-removal runs in a branch independent of the [ -d target ] dir guard, but the _seed1811 helper always creates the run dir when it writes a pointer, so 'own-slug pointer present, run dir already absent -> pointer still removed' is untested. A future refactor nesting pointer cleanup under the dir guard would keep the suite green while orphaning the pointer.
phase3_findings.non_blocking_basis: Behavior correct today; regression-durability only. Independently flagged and parked advisory on a prior iteration.

phase3_findings.summary: --root is only checked non-empty; the slug segment is regex-validated but the root prefix is not. Not exploitable via the trusted shipped callers (git rev-parse / resolve-main-root.sh); noted as an asymmetry only.
